what: On first open, a logo line is drawn in the middle of the background-colored curtain (each line 1s sine.inOut, .167s between the first and last line). At .8s the text below rises one character at a time, .05s apart, from 105% below over .3s, and the progress bar at the bottom fills by following the real loading (images · video) at 50fps, 10% of the remainder each tick. When full, it rests 1.3s, then the logo and bar (.1s later) slide 2rem up over .6s and the curtain lifts over 1s. When finished, it fires fx:loaded

options.hold: Seconds to rest once full, default 1.3
options.draw: Seconds to draw one line, default 1
options.spread: Start offset between first and last lines, default .167
options.gone: From the curtain starting to lift until it’s hidden, default .7
options.once: If session, it plays only on the first open in a tab (later pages fire fx:loaded right away, detail.instant)
options.--fx-bar-w / --fx-bar-h / --fx-bar-gap: Bar width · thickness · bottom margin, default 10rem · .6rem · 5vw
options.[data-fx-part=mark] > [data-fx-part=logo: Logo SVG (lines only, thickness set by the consumer) and a line beneath it

use: Your one-liner here

from.where: shared.js .kk-loader (logo line drawing vivus delayed 70·10 frames · imagesLoaded progress · seven characters · first session only, original #loader)
